notes: B-49 follow-up #2: Enchant creature is enforced for an Aura cast through the effect-less carrier. Capture Sphere's spell has no effect tree, so its enchant slot fell back to any permanent and it could be cast onto a land or an artifact and stay there. The compiled ENCHANT keyword now carries the Enchant line's filter (CR 702.5a) and the slot reads it (CR 303.4a): a land and an artifact are refused (off_population), the creature is legal, and the Aura stays attached to it through the opponent's next turn. Not asserted: 'doesn't untap during its controller's untap step' is not honoured by the untap step (the host untaps; same at HEAD with the enchant op), a separate gap.
